messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — code freeze goes into effect in ~3h (13:00 PT). If you need a late-merge exception, please open an exception PR and paste the link here. For triage we'll need: PR link, short risk statement, rollback plan, owner, and a test run link. We'll review exceptions at 12:30 PT.

release-bot: Automated reminder: release window locked at freeze time. Please file exceptions before the triage window.

ben: Do we want to bump the package version in the exception PRs or wait until we merge all approved items?

olivia: I can own the changelog. If you file an exception PR, add a single-line changelog under "Unreleased" and tag me @olivia. I'll consolidate.

aj: Requesting exception for PR #5123 — small kv-cache perf tweak. Tests pass locally. Risk: low, affects only cache eviction logic. Rollback: revert commit abcdef1. PR: https://git.company/PR/5123

sam: Which branch should the PR target? release/v1.8 or main? Want to avoid chasing multiple merges.

dana: Target release/v1.8 for this round. Staging is already synced to that branch. Suggested steps: `git checkout -b hotfix/kv-cache-5123` then `git cherry-pick -x abcdef1` and open PR against release/v1.8.

maya: @aj — OK to request. Two conditions before we escalate: 1) CI green, 2) include one-line changelog and rollback tag in PR body (format: `rollback: revert-abcdef1`). If both present, we'll fast-track triage.

release-bot: CI status for PR #5123: checks: unit-tests (green), integration (queued), lint (failed). See logs: https://ci.company/logs/5123/lint

aj: fixing lint now, will push within ~15m. thanks for the quick review.

ben: Suggestion: stagger merges to reduce risk — merge the lowest-risk exceptions first, wait ~10 minutes between merges, smoke test, then next. Keeps CI/infra load predictable.

maya: +1 to staggered merges. Add `canary-early` label to PRs we want to validate first.

olivia: Changelog note drafted for #5123: "reduce kv-cache memory spikes under high load" — will refine once PR description is final.

dana: Ops note: if an exception merges after 12:45 PT, we want a 30m canary in us-west-2 before full rollout. Please add `deploy: canary-usw2-30m` to the PR body.

aj: pushed lint fix and force-pushed. PR now shows all checks passing (unit/integration/lint). Updated PR body with changelog + `rollback: revert-abcdef1` + `deploy: canary-usw2-30m`. Link: https://git.company/PR/5123

maya: Adding conditional approval in the queue. @dana please confirm canary window ok from ops side.

dana: Canary window approved. Ops will monitor metrics. If any regression, tag `rollback-5123` and we'll revert.

release-bot: Exception recorded: EXC-2026-45. Triage scheduled at 12:30 PT.

ben: Thanks — sounds good. I'll coordinate merges and insert 10m gaps.

maya: Great job getting this sorted fast. Please keep this thread updated with merge time and smoke results. :thumbsup:

aj: will update after merge. ETA ~25m.

(End of thread)
